summary.text: Debbie Powers is a Republican state representative from the Caledonia-1 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Debbie Powers was born in Vermont and earned a bachelor's degree from Vermont Technical College.
Powers' career experience includes working as a customer service representative.
Powers won the Republican primary in August 2024 and defeated incumbent Bobby Farlice-Rubio in the November 2024 general election.
Powers' Democratic opponent in the 2026 general election is David Tucker.
